# Somrit Dasgupta

> Personal site of Somrit Dasgupta — software engineer working across TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, Go, and AWS. Writing, projects, and live GitHub activity.

Somrit builds backend systems and AI tools, ships in public, and keeps most of his work open source.

- [Blog](/blog): Long-form writing on engineering, TypeScript, React, AI, and open source.
- [Activity](/activity): Live GitHub repositories and recent commits.
- [CV](/cv): Curriculum vitae — experience, projects, skills, education, and certifications.
